blocks: The Max patcher inside Launchpad/Idea/Pick-MicroFreak-Presets-through-Live/Asset/Device/MF-Number-Pad/amxd, as editable JSON. A midiin feeds a v8.codebox that holds the device's JavaScript. The codebox feeds midiout and two live.comment boxes that show the slot being typed and the last slot sent.
The .amxd is this JSON behind a short ampf header for a MIDI Effect, whose ptch field gives the length of the JSON that follows.
